scenarioNames: Create new catalog and add image with hotspot
Edit existing hotspot position and data
groups.featureContent:
Feature: editor

  @happy_path @editor
  Scenario: Create new catalog and add image with hotspot
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides
    When I click the New catalog button and accept the prompt with "Test Catalog"
    And I add an image file to the catalog
    And I click inside the image to place a hotspot at offset 100, 100
    And I fill the link form with name "Part A" and address "part-a"
    And I fill the table row form with name "Part A Item" and SKU "SKU-001"
    And I save the catalog
    Then the catalog should be saved as "Test_Catalog.ecatm"
    And the hotspot should appear on the image
    And the table row "SKU-001" should be visible

  @happy_path @editor
  Scenario: Edit existing hotspot position and data
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides
    When I click the New catalog button and accept the prompt with "Edit Test"
    And I add an image file to the catalog
    And I click inside the image to place a hotspot at offset 50, 50
    And I fill the link form with name "Original" and address "original-addr"
    And I fill the table row form with name "Original Item" and SKU "ORIG-001"
    # TODO (unconfirmed): the UI path for editing an EXISTING hotspot's name/address was not found; only select, move, undo and redo are asserted.
    And I click on the hotspot to select it
    Then the hotspot should be marked as being edited
    When I drag the hotspot to a new position at offset 150, 150
    Then the document title should indicate unsaved changes
    And the hotspot should have moved from its original position
    When I press undo
    Then the hotspot should be back at its original position
    When I press redo
    Then the hotspot should be at the moved position again

  @edge_case @editor
  Scenario: Duplicate hotspot address validation
    # Observed: a second hotspot with an already used address is rejected: the link form stays open, no table row is created.
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides
    When I click the New catalog button and accept the prompt with "Duplicate Test"
    And I add an image file to the catalog
    And I click inside the image to place a hotspot at offset 80, 80
    And I fill the link form with name "First Hotspot" and address "shared-address"
    And I fill the table row form with name "First Item" and SKU "FIRST-001"
    And I click inside the image to place a hotspot at offset 200, 200
    And I submit the link form with name "Second Hotspot" and address "shared-address"
    Then the link form should remain open
    And the row form should not appear
    And the number of saved hotspots on the diagram should be 1

  @edge_case @editor
  Scenario: Empty catalog name
    # Observed: an empty name is not rejected; the editor creates a catalog anyway (Add image becomes enabled).
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides
    Then the Add image button should be disabled
    When I click the New catalog button and accept the prompt with ""
    Then the Add image button should be enabled
    And the Editor should remain functional with title containing "Editor"

  @edge_case @editor
  Scenario: Export protected without HTTPS
    Given I open the Editor page on an insecure context with file picker overrides
    When I create a new catalog named "InsecureTest" via prompt
    And I add a test image to the catalog
    And I click the Export protected button
    And I fill the protection password fields with "securepass123"
    And I click the Protect and download button
    Then no protected catalog file should be downloaded
    And the Editor should still be functional

  @edge_case @editor
  Scenario: Unsaved changes warning
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides for unsaved changes test
    When I create a new catalog named "UnsavedTest" via prompt
    And I add a test image to the catalog
    And I place a hotspot at offset 100, 100 on the image
    And I fill the hotspot link form with name "Test Link" and address "test-addr"
    And I fill the hotspot row form with name "Test Row" and SKU "TST-001"
    Then the document title should start with the unsaved changes marker
    When I attempt to close the page with beforeunload handling
    Then a beforeunload dialog should be triggered

  @edge_case @editor
  Scenario: Large image upload handling
    # Observed: a large image is accepted at its full size (no resize), appears in the image list and marks the catalog unsaved.
    Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides for large image test
    When I create a new catalog named "LargeImageTest" via prompt
    And I upload a large test image of 5000x5000 pixels
    Then the image list should contain 1 image
    And the document title should start with the unsaved changes marker

Feature: viewer

  @happy_path @viewer
  Scenario: Search functionality across catalog
    Given I open the Viewer with the furniture demo catalog
    When I open the search panel in the Viewer
    And I search for "door" in the Viewer
    Then the search results should contain "Door panel · SHK-002"
    When I change the search field filter to "SKU"
    And I search for "shk-001" in the Viewer
    Then the search results should contain "Cornice · SHK-001"
    When I change the search field filter to "Name"
    And I search for "Drawer" in the Viewer
    Then the search results should contain "Drawer · SHK-003"

  @happy_path @viewer
  Scenario: Cart workflow in viewer
    Given I open the Viewer with the furniture demo catalog
    When I add the first item to the cart in the Viewer
    Then the cart button should show "🛒 Cart (1)"
    And the first buy button should show "In cart ✓"
    When I add the second item to the cart in the Viewer
    Then the cart button should show "🛒 Cart (2)"
    When I open the cart dropdown in the Viewer
    Then the cart should contain 2 items with remove buttons
    And the checkout button should show "Checkout (2)"
    When I click the Clear cart button
    Then the cart button should show "🛒 Cart (0)"
    And the first buy button should show "Add to cart"

  @happy_path @viewer
  Scenario: Hotspot-table row highlighting sync
    Given I open the Viewer with the furniture demo catalog
    When I click on the first hotspot in the Viewer
    Then the corresponding table row should be selected
    When I click on the table row with address "shk-002"
    Then the hotspot for address "shk-002" should be highlighted

  @happy_path @viewer
  Scenario: Navigation hotspot between images
    Given I open the Viewer with the living-room demo catalog
    When I click on a navigation hotspot in the Viewer
    Then a different image should be loaded in the Viewer

  @happy_path @viewer
  Scenario: Quiz mode answer validation
    # TODO (unconfirmed): exact quiz interaction mechanics not fully observed; asserting visible render and interactivity
    Given I open the Viewer with the quiz demo catalog
    Then the quiz catalog should be rendered with questions visible
    And the quiz should be interactive with clickable answer options

  @edge_case @viewer
  Scenario: Invalid password for protected catalog
    Given I open the Viewer with the protected demo catalog
    Then the password unlock form should be visible
    When I enter the wrong password "wrongpassword" in the Viewer
    And I click the Unlock button in the Viewer
    Then the error message should show "Wrong password, or the file was modified. Check the password and try again."
    And no table rows should be visible in the Viewer

Feature: composer

  @happy_path @composer
  Scenario: Grid Composer complete workflow
    Given I open the Grid Composer page
    When I set the catalog name to "Test Grid Catalog"
    And I set the tiles per row to "4"
    And I upload 3 test photos for the Grid Composer
    And I upload a CSV table with 3 matching rows for the Grid Composer
    Then the photo status should show "Photos: 3"
    And the table status should show "Rows: 3"
    And the report should show "Every row has a photo and every photo has a row."
    When I click the Build catalog button
    Then the download link for the catalog should be visible

  @edge_case @composer
  Scenario: Grid Composer missing photos
    Given I open the Grid Composer page
    When I set the catalog name to "Missing Photos Catalog"
    And I upload a CSV table with 3 rows but no photos for the Grid Composer
    Then the table status should show "Rows: 3"
    And the photo status should show "No photos chosen yet."
    And the report should show a warning about missing photos for rows 1, 2, 3

  @edge_case @composer
  Scenario: Grid Composer mismatched photo numbers
    Given I open the Grid Composer page
    When I set the catalog name to "Mismatched Catalog"
    And I upload 2 test photos numbered 1 and 2 for the Grid Composer
    And I upload a CSV table with rows numbered 1, 3, 4 for the Grid Composer
    Then the photo status should show "Photos: 2"
    And the table status should show "Rows: 3"
    And the report should show a warning about missing photos for rows 3 and 4

scenarioNames: XSS in catalog name or hotspot data
groups.featureContent: Feature: security @security Scenario: XSS in catalog name or hotspot data Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides for XSS testing When I create a catalog with XSS payload name "" And I add a test image for XSS testing And I place a hotspot for XSS testing at offset 100, 100 And I fill the link form with XSS payload name "" and address "xss-test-001" And I fill the row form with XSS payload name "" and SKU "" Then the XSS payload should not execute And the XSS text should be visible literally in the page @security Scenario: Remote catalog URL validation # Observed: this is a browser-only app, so a file:// (or unreachable) address is rejected by the browser's own fetch: the copy dialog stays open and shows "Failed to fetch"; no catalog is opened. There is no server-side SSRF layer to test. Given I open the Editor page with file picker overrides for remote URL testing When I attempt to copy a remote catalog from a file URL "file:///etc/passwd" Then the remote copy should be rejected with the error "Failed to fetch" And no catalog should be opened
